rationale:
Positives: The agent verified identity via full name + zip, correctly identified the order with boots, checked product variants, obtained explicit confirmation before modifying the pending order, executed the change correctly, and reflected the updated item/options accurately.

Issues causing failure: 
- The agent stated the order was “currently pending” without tool evidence. While the modification ultimately succeeded (implying pending), asserting status without support violates the no-fabrication rule.
- The agent claimed “The small price difference has been refunded to your PayPal account.” The tools did not confirm any refund or payment transaction; this is an unsupported statement.
- The agent also asserted “no further modifications or cancellations can be made to this order,” which is not supported by the tools or stated policy. 

Because the final information included unsupported claims about refund processing and order-change restrictions, the conversation fails the requirement to avoid fabricated/unsupported information, despite the main change being completed correctly.
